sections.title: Identification and form
sections.text: The catalogue entry represents Solanum melongena, the eggplant. This branched herb or subshrub can reach about 2 m. The illustration shows a cultivated variety with elongated purple fruits; shape and colour vary widely among cultivars.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The alternate leaves are often hairy and the flowers are purple. The fruit is a berry eaten as a vegetable, usually cooked.

sections.title: Edibility and cautions
sections.text: The fruit is eaten as food. Other plant parts should not be considered edible; glycoalkaloids may occur in the foliage and green parts.
